newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 6.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's Daily Variety:
* The Broadway musical "The Life" received 12 nominations for Tony Award nominations on Monday, leading the other shows.
* Director Arthur Hiller has taken his name off his latest film and, under Directors Guild of America guidelines, mock documentary "An Alan Smithee Film" will list Alan Smithee as director.
* Walt Disney's ABC took the unusual step of giving ABC Entertainment president Jamie Tarses a public endorsement in an attempt to end speculation of a pending executive shakeup at the network.
* ABC's broadcast premiere of Forrest Gump topped part one of NBC's Invasion miniseries, propelling it to first place in overnight household ratings Sunday evening, according to Nielsen.

* Top exhibitors are hoping virtual games, outlet centers, restaurants and three-dimensional movie theatres, such as will open at Ontario Mills in California, will lure people away form sophisticated home theater systems.
* Director Jan De Bont's next film under his deal with News Corp 20th Century Fox will be thriller "Zero Hour," based on Joseph Finder's novel.
